title: RAMP KeyInvalidationList
description: Emergency key-revocation snapshot served at invalidation_url. Wire shape is protojson of ramp.v1.KeyInvalidationList with UseProtoNames=true.
$comment: revoked is NOT required: protojson with UseProtoNames omits an empty repeated field, so a 'nothing revoked' snapshot serializes to just {as_of}. Requiring revoked would reject that legitimate empty/cleared list. Absent revoked == empty revocation set. Mirrors the public_keys treatment in ramp-well-known.json.
